clip_record.notes: Aegis processes the clip window; timestamps in queries are relative to the clip start unless the adapter records otherwise.

inputs.official_splits: official train/val/test split files; never re-split

must_not_do: Mix clips from one video across splits.
Tune prompts, classes, or thresholds on the benchmark test split.
Report Aegis-specific metrics as official Ego4D leaderboard numbers.
Treat Ego4D results as clinical or assistive-care validation.
adapter_contract.purpose: Convert official Ego4D clips and annotations into Aegis pipeline inputs and evaluation records without changing benchmark semantics.

query_record.notes: Keep the original query text. Do not paraphrase benchmark queries after the protocol is frozen.

scoring.nlq: score_nlq(...) with temporal IoU thresholds 0.3 and 0.5
scoring.official_parity_required: Before publishing, re-score with the official Ego4D evaluation code on the official val/test splits.
scoring.vq2d: score_vq2d(...) with timestamp tolerance and box IoU 0.5

constraints.approval_lead_time: ≈48 h after signing the agreement, but do not promise a date
constraints.domain: general egocentric video, not assistive care
constraints.existing_aegis_data: demo01–demo05 are Hub egocentric iPhone clips, not Ego4D
